blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Persistent textual memory lets language-model agents reuse lessons from past tasks to improve on future multi-step tasks without retraining. Systems such as ACE and Dynamic Cheatsheet keep it as a playbook: lessons the agent writes after each task and reads in its prompt. A key challenge is to decide which lessons improve later tasks. Current systems leave the decision to the agent itself, which makes performance unstable: the same procedure can write a playbook that helps or one that falls up to 69.6 points below no playbook. These findings motivate valuing lessons by their measured effect on task success rather than by the agent's judgment. We propose Randomized Block Curation (RBC), which measures this effect with a randomized experiment on practice tasks. It groups related lessons into blocks large enough to move success measurably and, on each practice task, includes or leaves out every block at random. Random inclusion makes tasks with and without a block comparable, so the gap in their success estimates the block's effect. RBC keeps the blocks that help and, since the same procedure can write a helpful or a harmful playbook, grows several and serves whichever curated, whole or no playbook scores best on fresh practice episodes. Across two memory systems, three models and three benchmarks, RBC raises average success to 66.9, against 55.5 with the whole playbook, 54.1 with no playbook and 53.8 when the agent's own judgment picks the lessons to keep.
blocks.zh: 持续的文字记忆让语言-模型代理重新利用过去任务的经验教训来改进未来的多步骤任务而无需再培训. ACE和Dynamic Cheatsheet等系统将其保存为游戏本: 代理员在每次任务后写出的经验教训并及时阅读. 一个关键的挑战是如何决定哪些经验教训可以改进以后的任务。 目前的系统将决定权留给代理商自己,这使得性能不稳定:同样的程序可以写出一个有帮助的游戏本,也可以写出一个低于无玩本下69.6分的游戏本. 这些结论激励人们重视经验教训,因为它们对任务的成功有衡量效果,而不是代理人的判断。 我们提议随机区块校准(RBC),通过随机试验实践任务来衡量这种效果. 它将经验教训分成足以衡量成功与否的分块,在每项实践任务中,任意包括或排除每个分块。 随机的包含使得任务有和没有块可以比较,因此它们成功的缺口估计了块的效果. RBC保留有帮助的区块,由于同一程序可以写出有帮助的或有害的剧本,因此可以长出数个,并服务于在新鲜练习节目中成绩最佳的全能或无能的剧本。 通过两个内存系统,三个模型和三个基准,RBC将平均成功率提高到66.9分,而整个游戏本的成绩为55.5分,没有游戏本的成绩为54.1分,而代理商自己判断的成绩为53.8分.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Language-model agents carry out multi-step tasks such as operating apps, shopping online and household chores ( Trivedi et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2022 ; Shridhar et al., 2021 ) . Without retraining, which is costly
or impossible through a proprietary API, a growing line of work lets agents improve through persistent textual memory: lessons
the agent writes after each task and reads in its prompt later ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) ,
which we call a playbook . Systems maintain it differently, growing it lesson by lesson ( Zhang et al., 2026 , ACE;) , rewriting it as a whole ( Suzgun et al., 2026 , Dynamic Cheatsheet;) or retrieving
lessons by similarity ( Ouyang et al., 2026 , ReasoningBank;) , but they share one design
(Figure 1 a): the agent that writes the lessons also judges which to keep.

blocks.en:
Few works test this judgement against task success, and those that do compare whole memories ( Nguyen et al., 2026 ) . This
matters because added context can distract a model as easily as help it ( Shi et al., 2023 ) , and a lesson kept by
mistake is served on every later task. This work targets that decision, which lessons of a self-written playbook to serve, in two established memory systems, ACE and Dynamic Cheatsheet. We find their playbooks unstable: served whole, a playbook can fall up to 69.6 points below no playbook, and growing it again on the same tasks in another order can turn a helpful playbook harmful. Whether a playbook helps depends on the growth run that wrote it and is known only by measuring its effect on success.

很少有作品检验这种判断与任务的成功,那些确实比较整个记忆的作品(Nguyen等,2026年). 这个
因为增加上下文可以像帮助它那样容易地分散模型的注意力(Shi等人,2023年),以及保存的教训。
在以后的每一项任务中都会出现错误。 这项工作的目标是在两个既定的内存系统中,即ACE和Dynamic Cheatsheet中,作出这种决定,这是自写游戏本的教训。 我们发现他们的游戏本不稳定: 整个服务,一个游戏本可以跌到69.6分以下,没有游戏本,在同样的任务上再次增长,又一个顺序会让有用的游戏本变得有害. 游戏本是否有帮助取决于写作的成长跑道,并且只能通过衡量它对于成功的影响来得知.

blocks.en:
Letting the agent prune lessons it judges harmful does not remove the harm. Judging a lesson requires comparing episodes with and without it, but the agent sees only those that use it, and language
models are poor and biased judges of their own outputs ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) . So it tags lessons as helpful when they sound right, not when they raise success, even a harmful rule (Section 4 ). Context-valuation methods run this comparison but not for curation: they explain why a model gave one answer ( Cohen-Wang et al., 2024 ) or score memory entries one at a time ( Li et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , though one entry rarely moves success measurably, and return scores, not a playbook to serve (Figure 1 b).

blocks.en:
We propose Randomized Block Curation (RBC) , which supplies this comparison with a randomized experiment on
practice tasks (Figure 1 c). RBC groups related lessons into blocks large enough to move success measurably. Including each block at random on every practice task makes tasks with and without it comparable, so their success gap estimates its effect. RBC keeps the blocks that help within a token budget and, since a playbook’s value depends on its run, grows several and serves whichever curated, whole or no playbook scores best on fresh practice episodes. RBC leaves growth itself unchanged.

我们提议随机区块校正(RBC),
实践任务(图1c)。 区域局小组将经验教训分成足够大的组成部分,可以衡量成功与否。 将每个块随机地包括在每个实践任务上,使任务与没有它的任务具有可比性,因此它们的成功差距估计其效果. RBC将帮助的块保留在象征性的预算范围内,而且由于游戏本的价值取决于其运行情况,因此它会成长成数并服务于无论哪个曲目、整个或没有的游戏本的得分最好者。 RBC让增长本身保持不变.

blocks.en:
We test RBC on both systems with three models on three benchmarks. It lifts both on every model, averaging
66.9 task success against 55.5 with the whole playbook, 54.1 with no playbook and
53.8 when the agent picks lessons itself. It also avoids the harm: on ACE it never falls more than
0.8 points below no playbook, while every baseline falls at least 5.4 points
below it in some setting. When ACE’s playbooks, which never drop a lesson, grow for twice as long, RBC still beats the whole playbook and no playbook in every setting.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows. • Analysis. We show that self-written playbooks are unstable across growth runs and that the agent’s own judgement misses the harm. • Method. We propose RBC, which measures each block of lessons in a randomized experiment and serves only what helps. • Experiments. RBC is effective and robust across memory systems, models, benchmarks and rounds of memory updates.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献如下。 • 分析。 我们显示,自写游戏本在成长过程中是不稳定的,而代理商自己的判断也忽略了伤害。 • 方法。 我们建议RBC,它测量随机实验中的每一组教训,只服务于什么帮助。 • 实验。 RBC在内存系统,模型,基准和几轮内存更新中都是有效和强大的.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Self-written agent memory. Of the systems above, ACE tags each lesson as
helpful or harmful, and Dynamic Cheatsheet counts each entry’s successful uses. Other agents reflect on failures or store workflows ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , memory managers let the model decide what to store and recall ( Packer et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) , and ExpeL ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) scores each insight by the model’s votes.
In all of them a lesson stays because its writer believes it helps or because it resembles the task; Guo et al. (2026) find that self-improving agents also misjudge the checks they write, and we find the same for the lessons agents keep. The closest works measure success, but on whole units: Sarukkai et al. (2025) select among sets of trajectories and RSEA ( Nguyen et al., 2026 ) among memory rewrites, accepting one only if held-out success does not drop. RBC instead measures every block at once and chooses among growth runs and no playbook.

帮助或有害, 动态计费单计算每个条目的成功用途 。 其他代理商反思故障或存储工作流程(Shinn等,2023;Wang等,2025;),内存管理者让模型决定存储和召回的是什么(Packer等,2023;徐等,2025;ExpeL等,2024)通过模型的得分来评分每个见解.
因为作者认为这有帮助, (2026)发现自我改进的代理商也误判了他们所写的支票,我们发现对于学习的代理商也一样. 最接近的作品衡量成功,但整体单位: Sarukkai等 (2025年)在系列轨迹中选取,RSEA(Nguyen等,2026年)在记忆重写中选取,只有在被搁置的成功不下降的情况下才接受. 而RBC则同时测量每个街区,选择增长运行和没有游戏本.

blocks.en:
Valuing parts of a context. ContextCite ( Cohen-Wang et al., 2024 ) re-scores one answer on random subsets of sources with a linear fit, the design RBC applies to task success; Data Shapley ( Ghorbani and Zou, 2019 ) and Data Banzhaf ( Wang and Jia, 2023 ) value
training data, and SkillSV ( Li et al., 2026 ) and DG-Mem ( Wang et al., 2026 ) value agent skills or memory entries.
They stop at a value per entry, and a single entry rarely moves success beyond the noise of a few hundred episodes ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) ; RBC measures blocks, scores them by task success and decides what to serve within
a budget (Appendix F ). A block’s effect, its average gain, is its Banzhaf value ( Banzhaf, 1965 ) , which random inclusion estimates for every block at once.

他们以每个条目的值止步,单个条目很少能超越几百集的噪音(Zhao等,2026年);RBC测量块,通过任务成功得分,并决定在其中服务什么.
a 预算(附录F)。 一个区块的效果,它的平均收益,是它的Banzhaf值(Banzhaf,1965年),它一次随机地对每个区块进行包含估计.

blocks.en:
Choosing prompts and harmful context. Prompt optimizers such as DSPy ( Khattab et al., 2024 ) and GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) keep what scores best on a development set, and demonstration selection scores each
example over random prompts that contain it ( Chang and Jia, 2023 ; Nguyen and Wong, 2023 ) ; RBC applies this scoring to an agent’s memory, selecting among the agent’s lessons instead of rewriting them, so curating calls no language model (Appendix G ). Irrelevant text distracts language models ( Shi et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , so a longer playbook can hurt, and prompt compression ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) cuts a context by perplexity, not by effect on success; run-to-run variance is familiar from fine-tuning ( Dodge et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh:
选择诱因和有害的环境。 DSPy(Khattab等,2024年)和GEPA(Agrawal等,2026年)等快速优化器在开发集中保持最佳分数,示范选取分数各1分.
比起包含它的随机提示(Chang and Jia, 2023;Nguyen and Wong, 2023;RBC将这个分数应用到代理的记忆中, 选择代理的课而不是重写, 不相干文本分散了语言模型的注意力(Shi等,2023;Liu等,2024),因此更长的游戏本会伤害到人,而即时压缩(Jiang等,2023)则会通过迷惑来切除上下文,而不是影响成功;运行到运行的差异从微调中是熟悉的(Dodge等,2020.).

blocks.en: 3.2 Benchmarks and models
blocks.zh: 3.2 基准和模式

blocks.en:
Benchmarks. We conduct experiments on three benchmarks. In AppWorld ( Trivedi et al., 2024 ) , the agent
writes code against the APIs of nine apps. In WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) , it finds and buys a described
product. In ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) , it reaches a goal in a text household. They are scored by
task goal completion, purchase reward and success rate.

blocks.en: 4 Self-Written Memory Is Unreliable
blocks.zh: 4 自写记忆是不可靠的

blocks.en:
Before repairing self-written playbooks, we ask whether they need repair. We ran three growth runs in
each of the eleven ACE settings and checked each step of the loop (serve, grow, judge) against task success. We call a playbook harmful when it scores more than 5 points below no playbook; re-evaluating a playbook moved its score by at most 5.0 points, so such a gap is not noise.
blocks.zh:
在修复自写游戏本之前,我们询问它们是否需要修复. 我们跑过三次增长
ACE 的 11 个设置, 并检查循环的每个步骤( 服务器、 增长、 判断) 与任务成功相对应。 我们称游戏本在无游戏本下得分超过5分时是有害的;重新评价一游戏本最多移动了5.0分,所以这种差距不是噪音.

blocks.en:
Finding 1: serving the whole playbook can harm. Served whole, a playbook is unstable, even on one model and in one setting. It can lift success a long way: on 27B ALFWorld (Figure 2 , helps ) the first playbook raises it to 97.5 from
74.9 with no playbook. It can also erase most of it: on 27B AppWorld with pass/fail feedback ( all harm ) every playbook harms, one by 69.6 points. Of the first growth runs in the eleven settings, 5 help,
2 are level and 4 harm. A playbook is extra context, and context that does not
help can distract a model ( Shi et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , so serving one is a decision, not a default.

blocks.en:
Finding 2: the growth run decides whether the playbook harms. If this harm came from the model or benchmark, regrowing the playbook would reproduce it. It does not always: the same procedure on the same tasks, in another order, can write a helpful or a harmful playbook. On 27B AppWorld with per-test feedback,
the three runs score 82.5, 58.9 and 30.0
against 78.4 with no playbook (Figure 2 , mixed ): one helps, two harm. Such swings occur in 3 of the
6 settings with a harmful run, all on Qwen, whose runs differ only in task order and sampling. Dynamic Cheatsheet shows them too (Appendix B.2 ): on 9B WebShop one run gains 13.2 points over no playbook, another loses 14.0. An agent with one playbook cannot tell which kind it holds; only measuring can.

发现2:成长运行决定了游戏本是否有害. 如果这种伤害来自模型或基准,再生的游戏本会再现. 它并不总是:相同任务上相同的程序,按照另一种顺序,可以写出一个有用的或有害的游戏本. 在27B AppWorld的每个测试反馈,

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we showed that self-written playbooks are unstable: one procedure can grow a helpful or a harmful
playbook, and the agent’s own judgement cannot tell which. We proposed RBC, which measures instead:
it serves blocks of lessons at random on practice tasks to see what each does, and checks the curated set against
whole playbooks and no playbook before serving. Task success rises on average from 55.5 with the whole playbook to
66.9, and curating adds to choosing with fewer tokens, above all under long growth. An agent’s memory
should be measured, not judged.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们显示自写剧本不稳定:一种程序可以长出有用的或有害的.
游戏本,而代理商本身的判断也无法分辨出其中之一。 我们提议设立区域管制中心,以采取以下措施:
它在实践任务上随机提供各种经验教训,以了解每个人的工作,并对照
整个游戏本,没有游戏本之前服务。 任务成功率平均从55.5, 整个游戏本增加到
66.9, 以及校准, 增加了选择的代号, 首先是长期增长。 代理人的记忆
应该衡量,而不是判断。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Our evidence covers two memory systems, three benchmarks and three open-weight models, with playbooks we grew;
other memory systems, domains and larger or proprietary models remain to be tested. Within this scope, RBC values a block by its
average gain over the other blocks served with it, which makes curation exact when block effects add; when lessons
are hard to separate, as in a memory rewritten as a whole, it falls back on the best whole playbook, which still lifts
success but saves no context. RBC also trades extra episodes for reliability: it grows several playbooks, runs
practice rounds and needs practice tasks with an observable outcome. Since its guarantee holds on these practice
tasks, it works best when they resemble the tasks the agent will face. We fixed its constants on four ACE settings
and kept them unchanged elsewhere. Finally, we study playbooks fixed once grown; extending RBC to memory that grows
while it is served is a natural next step.
blocks.zh:
我们的证据包括两个内存系统、三个基准和三个开放量模型,以及我们成长的游戏本;
其他内存系统、域和更大的或专有的模型仍有待测试。 在这个范围内,RBC按其
所服务的其他区块的平均增益,当区块效应增加时,使校准准确;当经验教训增加时
很难分开,因为一个记忆 重写整体, 它倒回到最好的整个游戏本, 它仍然升起
成功但不保存上下文。 RBC 也为了可靠性而进行额外的交易:它生长出多本游戏本,运行
实践回合和需要实践任务,并有可观察到的结果。 由于其保证维持这些惯例
任务,当它们与代理将面临的任务相似时,效果最好。 我们固定了四个ACE的常数
让他们在别处保持原样 最后,我们学习游戏本 固定一次成长; 扩展 RBC 到内存增长
虽然它得到服务 是自然的下一步。

blocks.en: A.1 ACE as we run it
blocks.zh: A.1 ACE 当我们运行时

blocks.en: A playbook. Each line of an ACE playbook is one lesson with an id and the agent’s tags, for example: [sai-00001] helpful=166 harmful=0 :: Always extract dynamic identifiers (e.g., artist_id , track_id ) from the output of previous API calls and use them in subsequent requests. Never assume or hardcode IDs unless they are explicitly static and known in advance. The actor sees the lesson without the tags.
blocks.zh: 游戏本. ACE 游戏本的每行都有一个带ID和代理标记的课,例如:[sai-0001] 帮助=166 有害=0 总是从先前 API 调用输出中提取动态标识符( 如 artist_ id, track_ id),并在后续请求中使用. 永远不要假设或硬码ID,除非它们明确是静态的和事先知道的. 演员看课没有标签.

blocks.en:
Growth. We run ACE’s batched mode ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . On each batch of training tasks, the actor plays every
task with the current playbook; the Reflector reads each trajectory with its feedback and tags the lessons that bore
on it as helpful, harmful or neutral; the Curator writes new lessons, which are appended; and near-duplicate lessons
are merged. No step removes a lesson, and the whole playbook is served on every call (Whole). Growth runs differ in
the order of the training tasks and the actor’s sampling; a run stops once a pass over the training tasks grows the
playbook by less than 10%, after at most five passes.
blocks.zh:
增长. 我们运行ACE的分批模式(张等,2026年). 每批训练任务,演员每出一出
任务; 反射器用其反馈读取每个轨道,并标记所学到的经验教训
* 库拉托写出新的经验教训,附后;
合并。 任何步骤都无法消除一个教训,每个电话(Whole)都提供整个游戏本。 增长率不同
培训任务的顺序和演员的抽样; 一旦完成培训任务,运行就会停止。
游戏本数不到10%,最多通过5次。

blocks.en:
Feedback. On AppWorld, the Reflector sees either whether the task passed (pass/fail) or the result of each unit
test (per-test); the two grow different playbooks and count as different settings. On WebShop it sees the reward,
on ALFWorld success.
blocks.zh:

测试(per-test);两者会生长出不同的游戏本并算作不同的设置. 在WebShop上看到奖励,
关于ALFWorld的成功。

blocks.en: A.2 Dynamic Cheatsheet as we run it
blocks.zh: A.2 运行时的动态计费表

blocks.en:
We run Dynamic Cheatsheet’s cumulative mode ( Suzgun et al., 2026 ) with the actors and training tasks of our ACE
runs. After each batch of training tasks, one model call reads the current cheatsheet and the batch’s trajectories,
judges by itself, without the reward, which attempts succeeded, and writes a new cheatsheet that replaces the old one,
with a count of each entry’s successful uses. The cheatsheet is served whole; RBC treats its entries as lessons and is otherwise unchanged.

我们运行动态Cheatshet的累积模式(Suzgun等,2026年) 与我们的ACE的演员和培训任务
运行。 每批培训任务结束后,一个模型调用读取当前出轨表和批量的轨迹,
法官自己,没有奖励, 尝试成功, 写出一个新的欺骗表 取代了旧的,
列出每个条目的成功用途。 欺骗表是完整的;RBC将其条目视为课目,否则保持不变.

blocks.en: B.1 The harmful blocks
blocks.zh: 第B.1节 有害区块

blocks.en:
Table 4 lists every harmful block of the four harmful settings with one of its rules. The harm is not
scattered: in each setting it comes from one family of rules that sound useful.
blocks.zh:
表4列出了四个有害环境的每个有害区块及其规则之一。 伤害不是
散开:在每一个场合,它都来自一个听起来有用的规则家族。

blocks.en:
AppWorld: one family of rules. On all three AppWorld pass/fail settings the harmful blocks tell the agent to
pass an answer to complete_task , the call that ends the task, even when the task expects none. With such a
block, the agent answers more of these tasks and fails the check “answers match” more often. Under
pass/fail feedback the Reflector never sees the checker and writes rules for an imagined validator; under per-test
feedback it sees the failed tests and writes none.

放弃它,用b02块包括它买的更少。

blocks.en:
Task success cannot be replaced by an LLM judge. On AppWorld we also estimated block effects from a goal check
by the model itself instead of task success. With every judge prompt we tried, including a judge from another model, the set curated on the judge’s estimates failed on 27B and 9B
AppWorld pass/fail, in line with the known biases of LLM judges ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) : the measured
outcome is what makes RBC work.
blocks.zh:
任务成功不能被LLM法官所取代. 在AppWorld上,我们还从一个入球检查中估算出块效应
而不是成功完成任务。 在每位法官的促动下,我们进行了审判,包括一名来自另一模式的法官, 由法官估计的27B和9B的设定失败了
AppWorld pass/fail,符合LLM法官的已知偏见(郑等,2023;王等,2024:被测量者).
结果是使英国中央银行发挥作用。
